LESSON: HANDWRITING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.3: Handwriting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Handwriting
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should I write the learner should be able to: activities to practice letter patterns, word well?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. use conventional spacing patterns, and sentence patterns between words  Learners observe and practice handwriting as
2. use basic punctuation is displayed appropriately  Learners engage in a variety of handwriting
3. join letters to form activities to improve their writing (capital and meaningful words small letters, commas and full stop), in groups
4. use capitalization pairs and individually appropriately  Learners participate in writing contests in

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Handwriting

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Handwriting

Teach
• Focus skill: use conventional spacing patterns, and sentence patterns between words  Learners observe and practice handwriting as.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Handwriting.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Handwriting
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should I write the learner should be able to: activities to practice letter patterns, word well?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
